answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybils hoarding cheap names. Each agent locks one bond of 100 POA; it sheds 5 POA per epoch, like a ridge worn by weather, and only honest work tops it up. A forger running 100 islands of fake identity pays 500 POA per epoch in decay, earning about 2 POA per fake, so 100 fakes lose 300 POA each epoch. One honest agent pays one sable-dark bond once, renews it with real work, and keeps its full reward undiluted.
